Summary.Name: EchoPrime
Summary.Description: EchoPrime is a multi-view, view-informed, video-based vision-language foundation model for comprehensive echocardiogram interpretation
Summary.Developed_by: Milos Vukadinovic, Xiu Tang, Neal Yuan, Paul Cheng, Debiao Li, Susan Cheng, Bryan He, David Ouyang

Mechanism.Output: Multiple cardiac features and diagnoses interpretations
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Multiple echocardiogram videos from different views
Mechanism.Model_type: Vision-language foundation model with mVIT video encoder and BioMedBERT text encoder

Uses_and_directions.Benefits: Comprehensive multi-view echocardiogram interpretation with state-of-the-art performance
Uses_and_directions.General_use: Automated preliminary assessment of comprehensive echocardiography
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Ensure multiple standard echocardiographic views are available

Warnings_and_limitations.Generalizability: Further analyses in diverse clinical settings required
Warnings_and_limitations.Clinical_rationale: Model designed to mimic clinical expert interpretation process
